title: XPLAT-010 Suite Manifest
description: Single per-layer source of truth for deterministic suite composition. Read by tests/speckit-pro/run-all.py (developer UX) and by the shipped suite gate speckit_pro_runner/gates/suite.py (CI dispatch). Replaces the hardcoded DEFAULT_SUITE/EXTENDED_SUITE/ALLOWED_LAYERS tuples and the native check_layer5/7/8 implementations. Composition changes are manifest-only edits; shipped-runner bytes change only when dispatch behavior changes.

default.description: true if the layer is in the default deterministic suite (--all without extras).

execution.description: Whether run-all.py executes the layer or prints its commands.

live_only.description: true for layers that require --live (Layers 2/3/6 live-AI evals).

counted_in_total.description: false for the toolchain preflight layer; true for deterministic test layers whose passed/total counts roll into the headline.

dispatch.description: python-module = dispatched to a repo-side Python module (Layers 1/4/7/8, and Layer 5 once ported); internal-check = run in-process inside the shipped suite gate (toolchain; Layer 5 transitionally with a replaced body); shell-legacy-transitional = temporary .sh dispatch permitted ONLY between PR 2 and the layer's port-PR boundary, removed by PR 10.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the layer's test module (Python once ported; .sh only during the shell-legacy-transitional window).

baseline.description: Repo-relative pointer to the committed count-parity baseline file (the single count of record, eliminating manifest-vs-baseline drift), or null for layers with no per-script parity baseline (e.g. toolchain, or native-Python modules born without a bash predecessor).
